# How long each package takes under `go test -race`, used only to balance shards.
#
# ONLY THE HEAVY PACKAGES ARE LISTED. Race cost here is a tight body (median
# 3.0s) with a handful of outliers, so packing from these ten measured within 1%
# of packing from the complete package list — the outliers are the only entries
# worth recording, and everything unlisted takes the planner's default.
#
# A NEW PACKAGE NEEDS NO ENTRY HERE. The planner takes its package list from
# `go list`, so an unlisted package still runs, on its default weight. Nothing
# about correctness depends on this file; only balance does.
#
# Seconds are wall-clock from one 2026-09-18 darwin/arm64 run under `-race` with
# a warm build cache. They are RELATIVE WEIGHTS for packing, not a prediction of
# the CI runner's timings, and they should be refreshed when the shape of the
# suite changes rather than trusted indefinitely.
#
# <seconds> <import path>
